```{r setup}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(DT)

demo_data <- read_xpt("DEMO_L.XPT")

demo_cleaned <- demo_data %>%
  mutate(
    income_4cat = case_when(
      INDFMPIR < 1.30                     ~ "Low Income",
      INDFMPIR >= 1.30 & INDFMPIR < 3.50  ~ "Middle-Low Income",
      INDFMPIR >= 3.50 & INDFMPIR < 5.00  ~ "Middle-High Income",
      INDFMPIR >= 5.00                    ~ "High Income",
      TRUE                                ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(
      levels = c("Low Income", "Middle-Low Income", "Middle-High Income", "High Income")
    ),
    gender = factor(
      ifelse(RIAGENDR == 1, "Male", "Female"),
      levels = c("Male", "Female")
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      RIDAGEYR < 30                 ~ "<30",
      RIDAGEYR >= 30 & RIDAGEYR < 50 ~ "30-49",
      RIDAGEYR >= 50                ~ "50+"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("<30", "30-49", "50+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(income_4cat), !is.na(gender), !is.na(age_group))

navy_blue     <- "#12263F"
golden_yellow <- "#B88E10"
accent_red    <- "#B0413E"

n_total    <- nrow(demo_cleaned)
pct_low    <- mean(demo_cleaned$income_4cat == "Low Income") * 100
pct_female <- mean(demo_cleaned$gender == "Female") * 100
```

## Row {height="40%"}

### Column {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Income Category"
demo_cleaned %>%
  count(income_4cat) %>%
  mutate(proportion = percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1)) %>%
  rename(
    `Income Category` = income_4cat,
    `Number of Participants` = n,
    `Proportion of Sample` = proportion
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

### Column {width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Age Distribution"
demo_cleaned %>%
  count(age_group) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = navy_blue) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Row {height="40%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Income by Gender"
ggplot(demo_cleaned, aes(y = income_4cat, fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), name = "Proportion") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(demo_cleaned$income_4cat)), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = navy_blue, "Female" = golden_yellow), name = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Income by Age Group"
ggplot(demo_cleaned, aes(y = age_group, fill = income_4cat)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), name = "Proportion") +
  scale_y_discrete(name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Income Category") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
